overview: Deterministic E2E coverage for discovering/creating/opening matters and progressing setup through upload/readiness states with explicit guidance.
successMetrics: Validation and blocked-readiness states remain explicit.
uiNotes: Saved-view chips must filter list deterministically.
Create matter requires explicit name input.
Readiness reasons must map to actionable next steps.

importFormat.description: No external import; scenario uses fixture seeding plus upload in app flow.

rules: Blocked readiness must explain why and what to do next.

stories.title: Discover, Create, Upload, Reach Readiness Guidance
stories.description: As an operator, I need to move from discovery to setup completion with explicit upload/readiness feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Given seeded matters and upload capability, `/matters` supports search and saved-view filtering with deterministic results.
When creating a matter with valid name and uploading a document, setup rows progress through ingest statuses.
Then readiness copy shows `ready`, `blocked`, or `already complete` with explicit next action.
Example: blocked readiness due to missing docs shows clear instruction to upload/index required documents.
Negative: submitting create without name returns validation and creates no matter.
